run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T17:08:01Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is backed by observed error spans: over the hour ending 17:31:55 the error share computed from traces_span_metrics_calls_total for frontend-proxy is ~0.0212 (2.12%), matching the alert annotation's 2.1111, and both of its operations ('ingress' and 'router frontend egress') carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR. The errors are not generated by frontend-proxy itself: its Envoy access log shows HTTP 500 responses on GET /api/data marked 'via_upstream', i.e. returned by the frontend, and the pod has 0 restarts with flat CFS throttling. Inside the frontend, every error span in the hour sits on the ad-service call path (GET /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, executing api route (pages) /api/data; all other frontend operations show 0 errors), and the frontend's raw /api/data error counter is flat at 375 until 17:14 and then rises ~50/min to 856 at 17:24. The ad service is the origin of the failures visible here: its share of error spans over the hour is 0.137 (13.7%, highest of the services returned), its oteldemo.AdService/GetAds server spans switch to STATUS_CODE_ERROR from ~17:15 while successful GetAds calls collapse from ~0.94/s to ~0.07/s, and its container log shows repeated 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed' lines from ~17:14:27. At the same time ad's GetAds p95 latency rose from ~90-180 ms to 449-595 ms while its median stayed ~1.4 ms and its internal handler spans (getRandomAds, getAdsByCategory) stayed ~1.9 ms, and ad's CPU usage rose 0.006->0.016 cores with CFS throttled periods rising ~5x (0.9-1.7/s -> 4.1-5.2/s) against a 50m CPU limit, while sibling pods on the same node kept flat throttling. The ad Deployment/Pod is therefore the object the failure traces to; why it started failing (CPU-quota throttling/GC pressure versus an application-level fault) could not be pinned down, and the trigger, the underlying exception text and the state after ~17:24 remain unknown.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own trace metrics show error spans on both of its operations over the hour ending 17:31:55: 'ingress' increase 516.06 errors vs 23221.84 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and 'router frontend egress' increase 490.67 errors vs 23247.24 UNSET (span status 'recorded'); its overall error share for the hour is 0.021205 (2.12%), the same magnitude as the alert annotation's 2.1111.

frontend-proxy's 5m error rate was 0 to 0.0163/s up to 17:13, then rose to 0.178/s at 17:15 and 0.531/0.867/0.737/1.004/0.809/0.446 per s at 17:17/17:19/17:21/17:23/17:25/17:27 on 'ingress' (its 'router frontend egress' series follows the same shape).

Raw counter values for frontend-proxy 'ingress' show STATUS_CODE_ERROR growing from 617 at 17:14:00 to 1109 at 17:24:00 (+492, about 50/min) while STATUS_CODE_UNSET grows normally (23650 -> 29968, about 630/min); both series stop changing after 17:24:00 even though the returned series extend to 17:28, so the post-17:24 state is unknown.

frontend-proxy's Envoy access log shows the failing requests as 500s returned by the frontend, not by the proxy: 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=accessories HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream' (21 bytes upstream, 4 ms) and 'GET /api/data?contextKeys=travel ... 500 - via_upstream'; one 'GET /api/products/66VCHSJNUP ... 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' line also appears, while surrounding requests are 200.

All frontend error spans in the hour are on the ad call path and no other frontend operation has errors: 'GET /api/data' 489.15, 'GET' 489.15, 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' 489.15, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 489.15, with 0 for grpc oteldemo CartService/AddItem, CartService/GetCart, CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, executing api route /api/cart and /api/checkout, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout and tcp.connect.

The frontend's raw GET /api/data error counter was completely flat at 375 from 16:55 through 17:14, then climbed 417 (17:15), 463, 512, 551, 600 (17:20), 707, 769, 816, 856 (17:24) and stayed at 856 through the last sample at 17:28.

Across the services returned, the highest error share for the hour is ad at 0.137, followed by frontend-proxy 0.0212, frontend 0.0189, fraud-detection 0.0011, recommendation 0.0005, while payment and accounting return 0.

The ad service's server span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' starts reporting STATUS_CODE_ERROR at the 17:17 point (0.396/s) and reaches 0.719/s at 17:21, 0.985/s at 17:23 and 0.793/s at 17:25, while its STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate collapses from ~0.94-1.09/s before 17:13 to 0.0917/s at 17:21 and 0.0679/s at 17:27; its own getAdsByCategory and getRandomAds spans report no errors.

The ad pod's container log contains repeated 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@<id>' lines at roughly 1-2/s from about 17:14:27 onward (453 matching lines in 17:05-17:31), interleaved with normal 'no baggage found in context' and 'Targeted ad request received for [..]' lines, so the service was still receiving and handling requests while those exceptions were thrown.

Ad's GetAds latency degraded in the tail only: p95 went from 87.8-204.9 ms (16:51-17:13) to 448.9 ms at 17:17, 532.2/594.9 ms at 17:19/17:21 and 333.8-390.0 ms afterwards, while the p50 stayed 1.34-1.54 ms throughout; ad's internal spans stayed fast (getRandomAds p95 flat at 1.90 ms; getAdsByCategory p95 1.9 ms with isolated 73.7-75.0 ms readings).

From the frontend side, the client span for the ad call ('grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds') p95 rose from 182-342 ms before 17:13 to 640 ms at 17:15, 1253 ms at 17:17, 1524 ms at 17:19 and 597-747 ms at 17:21-17:28.

The ad container is limited to cpu 50m and memory 450Mi (requests 10m/225Mi); during the incident its CPU usage rose from ~0.0060-0.0083 cores (16:51-17:13) to 0.0119-0.0164 cores (17:15-17:25), its CFS throttled-period ratio rose from 0.082-0.184 to 0.229 at 17:14 and 0.339-0.476 afterwards, and its memory working set/max usage grew from 322.2 MB/323.1 MB at 16:52 to 365.4 MB/366.3 MB at 17:28.

The throttling increase is specific to the ad container: throttled CFS periods per second for ad rose from ~0.87-1.66 to 3.39 (17:15), 4.98, 5.22, 4.08, 4.32 (17:15-17:23), while frontend stayed 6.1-6.8, frontend-proxy 1.79-2.38, cart 1.26-2.91 and otel-collector 3.19-3.80 over the same window; ad, frontend, frontend-proxy, cart and 10 other otel-demo pods all share node i-00919402a8ea35027.

The ad workload showed no restart or eviction damage: the ad pod is Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState termination reason/exit code, the ad Deployment has 1 desired/1 ready/1 available replica, and all 21 otel-demo pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts; every node reports Ready with MemoryPressure/DiskPressure/PIDPressure all False.

frontend-proxy itself looks like a relay rather than the faulty component: it is Running/Ready with 0 restarts, its CFS throttling is flat (1.79-2.38/s across the window), it continues to serve ~10-12 ingress spans/s (UNSET counter 10635 -> 29968 between 16:55 and 17:24), and its access log shows the failing /api/data requests as 500 responses coming 'via_upstream' from frontend.

The current flagd configuration (flagd-config configMap, mounted into the flagd Deployment, which ad reaches via FLAGD_HOST=flagd) has every flag at defaultVariant 'off', including adFailure, adHighCpu and adManualGc, so no fault-injection flag is enabled in the configuration as it exists at query time.

The only Jaeger trace sample delivered for frontend-proxy covers spans started around 16:52:04-16:52:07 (its rows are 200 and 308 responses on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' parented by load-generator GET/POST spans), so this sample predates the error onset and shows no incident-window spans.

The frontend-proxy error-rate alert is being driven by a propagation chain: the ad service began failing and slowing its GetAds RPCs at ~17:14-17:15, the frontend's only erroring operation is its ad call so GET /api/data returned 500, and frontend-proxy recorded those upstream 500s as error spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress'. The timing agreement (frontend error counter flat through 17:14 then +50/min; ad GetAds errors from the 17:17 point; ad exceptions from ~17:14:27) supports this chain but is correlation, not a proven causal link.

A plausible mechanism inside ad is CPU-quota starvation: the ad container is capped at cpu 50m, its CPU usage rose ~2.7x and its CFS throttled-period ratio rose ~5x at the same time its GetAds p95 rose 4x and its client-observed latency reached 1.5 s, which would delay gRPC response handling and cause the observed stream exceptions. This is not proven: the average usage (max 0.0164 cores) stayed well under the 50m quota, the median GetAds latency stayed 1.4 ms, and throttling was already 10-18% before the incident.

An alternative mechanism is an application-level fault inside the ad service (its GetAds path throwing per-request exceptions rather than timing out), which would explain fast-failing requests, unchanged median/internal-handler latency, and the exception log lines; the currently-read flagd configuration has adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc all 'off', so an active flag-driven fault is not supported by the configuration as read now, but a flag that was toggled and reverted before this query cannot be excluded.

Node-level resource pressure on i-00919402a8ea35027 (which hosts ad, frontend and frontend-proxy) is rejected as the cause: the node reports Ready with MemoryPressure, DiskPressure and PIDPressure all False, and CFS throttling of the co-located frontend, frontend-proxy, cart and otel-collector pods stayed flat while only ad's throttling rose ~5x.

gaps: No span-level error detail (status code, message) is available for the ad failures: a traces_search for service 'ad' in 17:15-17:31 returned status no_data (no traces), and the only frontend-proxy trace sample covers ~16:52, so the gRPC status behind 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' STATUS_CODE_ERROR is unknown.

The RequestErrorRate alert rule could not be inspected: list_prometheus_rules returned no_data both for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and for type=alert, so the alert's exact expression, window and threshold are unknown, and the reported startsAt 17:08:01 cannot be reconciled with the observed frontend-proxy error accumulation (sporadic single-digit counts ~17:09-17:13, sustained growth from 17:14-17:15).

The underlying exception thrown by the ad service is not visible in the container log lines that were read; only the wrapper text 'Exception while executing runnable io.grpc.internal.ServerImpl$JumpToApplicationThreadServerStreamListener$1HalfClosed@<id>' is present, so whether it is a cancellation, an internal error or a resource-induced failure is undetermined.

traces_span_metrics_calls_total for frontend-proxy and frontend stopped changing after ~17:24 while the returned series extended to 17:28, so impact after 17:24 is unknown; the reason for that stall was not investigated.
The change_history integration is not available, so no deployment, configuration or flag change can be confirmed for the ~17:14 onset.
The flagd configMap reflects only its state at query time (~17:33); whether adFailure/adHighCpu/adManualGc was enabled earlier in the incident cannot be verified.

No JVM/heap metrics exist for the ad container — queries for jvm_memory_used_bytes and jvm_cpu_recent_utilization_ratio scoped to pod ad-554b849958-sk6fg returned no_data, and the only jvm_memory_used_bytes series present belongs to pod otel-collector-564d9c7987-fvlzk — so GC pressure inside ad could not be measured; ad memory (366 MB of its 450Mi limit) did not reach the limit during the observed window.

Log reads for the flagd pod (containers init-config, flagd, flagd-ui) and the otel-collector pod returned no_data / no matching lines, so no flagd or collector-side error could be confirmed or excluded.

Services whose names did not appear in the per-service error-ratio result (cart, checkout, currency, email, product-catalog, shipping, quote, image-provider, kafka, load-generator) were not individually verified for errors, so they are not proven healthy.
An attempt to rank all otel-demo pods by CFS throttle ratio returned no_data, so only the five pods explicitly queried were compared.
next_steps: Retrieve the Alertmanager/Prometheus rule definition for RequestErrorRate to confirm its expression, window and threshold, and compare with the reported startsAt 2026-11-16T17:08:01Z.
Capture the full ad-service stderr/stack trace (or enable exception logging) around 17:14-17:24 to identify the exception class and gRPC status behind the failing GetAds calls.
Check flagd/flagd-ui audit or configuration history for toggles of adFailure, adHighCpu or adManualGc around 17:14, since the current configMap only shows the present state.
Review whether the ad Deployment's 50m CPU / 450Mi memory limits are the intended sizing, given the 5x rise in CFS throttled periods during the incident.
Restore/validate the Jaeger and traces-metrics ingestion path so that traces and counters after ~16:52 and ~17:24 are available for post-incident analysis.
